description: Full-text search over the published robot sheets: accents ignored, word starts, synonyms, close spelling, ranked by relevance. `matchQuality` says whether all the words, some of them or a close spelling were found. `locale: "fr"` for French texts and addresses.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

query.description: Words to look for in the robot sheets, for example "humanoid kitchen" or "Unitree G1" (2 to 120 characters).

name: search_robots
title: Search robots
